sentences.text: This slim volume is packed with tips to help wage slaves as well as lottery winners get the most "happiness bang for your buck."
sentences.translation: 懒笔记 · https://english-exam.lazynote.cn/kaoyan/sections/2014-english-two/section2-part-a-1/?f=p · 在线使⽤效果更好their commutes to work, spend more time with friends and family and less of it watching television(something the average American spends a whopping two months a year doing, and is hardly jollier forit). Buying gifts or giving to charity is often more pleasurable than purchasing things for oneself, andluxuries are most enjoyable when they are consumed sparingly. This is apparently the reason McDonald'srestricts the availability of its popular McRib – a marketing trick that has turned the pork sandwich intoan object of obsession.这本薄薄的小册子充满了帮助工薪族和彩票中奖者从每一分钱中获得最多"幸福回报"的建议。似乎大多数人如果能缩短上班通勤时间，花更多时间与朋友和家人相处，少看电视（美国人平均每年花整整两个月时间看电视，却并未因此更快乐），生活会更好。为他人购买礼物或捐赠给慈善机构往往比为自己购物更令人愉悦，而奢侈品在节制消费时最令人享受。这显然就是McDonald's限制其广受欢迎的McRib供应的原因——这一营销手段将这款猪肉三明治变成了令人痴迷的对象。

We rose-tint our memories and put ourselves into self-affirming situations.
sentences.translation: 我们给记忆涂上玫瑰色,并把自己置于自我肯定的情境中。当受到批评时,我们会变得防御性很强,并对他人应用负面刻板印象来提升自己的自尊。我们四处走动,认为自己很了不起。

sentences.text: We become defensive when criticised, and apply negative stereotypes to others to boost our own esteem.
We stalk around thinking we're hot stuff.
Psychologist and behavioural scientist Nicholas Epley oversaw a key study into self-enhancement and attractiveness.
sentences.translation: 懒笔记 · https://english-exam.lazynote.cn/kaoyan/sections/2014-english-two/section2-part-a-2/?f=p · 在线使⽤效果更好quickly chose a falsely flattering image – which most did – they genuinely believed it was really howthey looked.心理学家和行为科学家Nicholas Epley监督了一项关于自我提升和吸引力的重要研究。他没有让人们简单地与他人比较评价自己的美貌,而是要求他们从一组照片中识别出自己的原始照片,这组照片包括经过修改显得更有吸引力和更没有吸引力的版本。该研究指出,视觉识别是"一个自动的心理过程,快速而直觉地发生,几乎没有明显的有意识思考"。如果受试者快速选择了一张虚假美化的图像——大多数人确实如此——他们真诚地相信那就是他们真实的样子。

sentences.text: Rather than have people simply rate their beauty compared with others, he asked them to identify an original photograph of themselves from a lineup including versions that had been altered to appear more and less attractive.
Visual recognition, reads the study, is "an automatic psychological process, occurring rapidly and intuitively with little or no apparent conscious deliberation".

The concept of man versus machine is at least as old as the industrial revolution, but this phenomenon tends to be most acutely felt during economic downturns and fragile recoveries.
sentences.translation: 人与机器对抗的概念至少与工业革命一样古老，但这种现象往往在经济衰退和脆弱复苏期间感受最为强烈。然而,如果认为我们现在只是在经历繁荣与萧条周期的痛苦一面,那就错了。某些工作已经永远消失了,被机器淘汰了。由于技术对吞噬人类工作有着永不满足的欲望,这种现象将继续以我们无法立即预见的方式重塑我们的经济。

sentences.text: And yet, it would be a mistake to think we are right now simply experiencing the painful side of a boom and bust cycle.
Certain jobs have gone away for good, outmoded by machines.
Since technology has such an insatiable appetite for eating up human jobs, this phenomenon will continue to restructure our economy in ways we cannot immediately foresee.
When there is rapid improvement in the price and performance of technology, jobs that were once thought to be immune from automation suddenly become threatened.
sentences.translation: 当技术的价格和性能快速提升时,那些曾经被认为不会被自动化取代的工作突然变得岌岌可危。这一论点吸引了大量关注,源于Erik Brynjolfsson和Andrew McAfee合著的《与机器赛跑》一书的成功,两位作者均来自MIT数字商业中心。懒笔记 · https://english-exam.lazynote.cn/kaoyan/sections/2014-english-two/section2-part-a-3/?f=p · 在线使⽤效果更好

sentences.text: This argument has attracted a lot of attention, via the success of the book Race Against the Machine, by Erik Brynjolfsson and Andrew McAfee, who both hail from MIT's Center for Digital Business.
This is a powerful argument, and a scary one.
sentences.translation: 这是一个有力且令人恐惧的论点。然而,《拉力》及其他著作的作者John Hagel表示,Brynjolfsson和McAfee忽略了这些工作首先如此容易被技术取代的原因。

sentences.text: And yet, John Hagel, author of The Power of Pull and other books, says Brynjolfsson and McAfee miss the reason why these jobs are so vulnerable to technology in the first place.
When the government talks about infrastructure contributing to the economy the focus is usually on roads, railways, broadband and energy.
sentences.translation: 当政府谈论基础设施对经济的贡献时,焦点通常集中在道路、铁路、宽带和能源上。住房很少被提及。

sentences.text: Housing is seldom mentioned.
Nevertheless, the affordable housing situation is desperate.
sentences.translation: 然而,经济适用房的状况令人绝望。等候名单一直在增加,而我们建造的新房数量根本不够。

sentences.text: Waiting lists increase all the time and we are simply not building enough new homes.
The comprehensive spending review offers an opportunity for the government to help rectify this.
sentences.translation: 全面支出审查为政府提供了一个帮助纠正这一问题的机会。政府需要摒弃历史偏见,采取一些措施来解决我们迫切的住房需求。懒笔记 · https://english-exam.lazynote.cn/kaoyan/sections/2014-english-two/section2-part-a-4/?f=p · 在线使⽤效果更好

sentences.text: It needs to put historical prejudices to one side and take some steps to address our urgent housing need.

Ministers should also look at creating greater certainty in the rental environment, which would have a significant impact on the ability of registered providers to fund new developments from revenues.
sentences.translation: 部长们还应考虑在租赁环境中创造更大的确定性,这将对注册供应商从收入中资助新开发项目的能力产生重大影响。

sentences.text: While the government's commitment to long-term funding may have changed, the very pressing need for more affordable housing is real and is not going away.
sentences.translation: 虽然政府对长期资助的承诺可能已经改变,但对更多经济适用房的迫切需求是真实存在的,而且不会消失。
